results.llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertions are the FY25 quantified land outcomes: (1) 175ha disturbed, (2) ~221ha progressively rehabilitated, and (3) ~3,800ha set aside for conservation. No evidence fields were provided to substantiate any of these figures or even confirm the activities occurred in FY25. Because the claim is entirely numerical and time-bound, and there is no supporting data, disclosure, or documentation in the provided evidence, none of the material assertions are verified.
